why: Settled (Readings, half b): a self-reference looks back at the fixed-up path only — the original-path fallback is for the application root (L1043-1047), not for a field referring to itself — unlike 009/011/014, where an optional vanishes without a cycle and the root must still be tried. typesafe/config reads it so: a += 2 included at k is k.a = ${?k.a} [2], k.a has no earlier value, and the root's unrelated a = [1] is not looked at: k.a is [2]. lightbend/config#863 keeps a swallowed cycle from falling back to the root, so this row stays as it is.
